name: Broken Hill Gold Ltd.
summary: Broken Hill Gold Ltd. operates as a gold exploration company in Australia. Its flagship property is the Alice River gold project that comprises a portfolio of eight mining leases and five exploration permits for minerals tenements located in the Alice River region of north Queensland. The company was formerly known as Pacgold Limited and changed its name to Broken Hill Gold Ltd. in August 2026. Broken Hill Gold Ltd. was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Brisbane, Australia.
